resources.string: CoPlanly can send anonymous usage statistics and crash reports. They tell us which screens are slow and which crashes are real, and nothing else.
Never sent: your children\'s names or health details, your messages, your events, your expenses, or your receipts. Those stay on your device and between the two of you.
You can change this at any time in Settings. The app works exactly the same either way.
Anonymous statistics and crash reports. Never your family\'s data.
